prompts.System Overview: Describe product boundaries, users and the main end-to-end flow in a short overview.
prompts.System Diagram: Link the real module-oriented SVG and explain its boundaries.
prompts.Document Navigation: Link every selected topic with a short reading purpose.
prompts.Assumptions and Open Decisions: Distinguish confirmed decisions, assumptions and critical blockers.

prompts.Selected Technologies: Record layers, platform/runtime requirements and compatibility confidence.
prompts.Alternatives and Tradeoffs: Compare viable alternatives with concrete benefits, costs and rejection reasons.
prompts.Verification Evidence: Link official sources or observed results; identify version claims needing verification.

prompts.Entities and Ownership: Define entities, relationships, identity and ownership constraints.
prompts.Persistence and Consistency: Describe storage, transactions, conflicts and authoritative data ownership.
prompts.Lifecycle and Recovery: Explain retention, deletion, migrations and recovery; reference specialized policies where selected.
prompts.Contracts and Examples: Link applicable authoritative schemas and representative schema-validated JSON examples under contracts/ and examples/. Distinguish data records from API projections. Record explicit non-applicability instead of inventing interfaces.

prompts.Boundaries and Providers: Identify clients, backend boundaries and third-party providers, including explicit none.
prompts.Contracts and Errors: Specify inputs, outputs, authorization boundary, validation, failures and retry/idempotency behavior.
prompts.Compatibility and Failure Handling: Explain provider/client capabilities, unavailable services and version constraints.
prompts.Contracts and Examples: Link applicable authoritative schemas and representative schema-validated JSON examples under contracts/ and examples/. Distinguish data records from API projections. Record explicit non-applicability instead of inventing interfaces.

prompts.Trust and Access: Define actors, trust boundaries, access controls and authorization.
prompts.Sensitive Data and Secrets: Describe secret storage, data exposure, privacy and deletion expectations.
prompts.Threats and Mitigations: Cover untrusted content, abuse/failure paths and security verification.

prompts.Story and Criteria Coverage: Map each story acceptance criterion to design documents and verification scenarios.
prompts.Test Layers and Environments: Specify unit, integration and end-to-end coverage appropriate to selected platforms.
prompts.Failure and Compatibility Tests: Include invalid input, permissions, retries, recovery, supported clients/devices and concurrency.
prompts.Evidence and Release Gates: State what must be observed before implementation readiness/release; do not claim unrun tests passed.

prompts.Decision Records: Preserve ADR IDs, decision, rationale, consequences, alternatives and related US IDs.
prompts.Unresolved Tradeoffs: Identify owners, validation paths and blocking vs nonblocking decisions.

prompts.Routing and Navigation: Describe routes, navigation and feature boundaries.
prompts.State and Data Flow: Distinguish server state, editable drafts, validation and failure states.
prompts.Components and Folder Structure: Define component ownership, accessibility responsibilities and frontend folders.
prompts.Browser Compatibility: State browser targets and relevant constraints.

prompts.Services and Responsibilities: Define service/module boundaries and request flows; explain N/A if no separate backend.
prompts.Validation and Execution: Describe validation, transactions, background work boundaries and failures.
prompts.Backend Folder Structure: Give an implementable folder plan or explicit reason not applicable.

prompts.Environments and Infrastructure: Describe local/hosted environments, chosen provider or Compose services.
prompts.Configuration and Readiness: Define secrets, networking, startup health and migrations.
prompts.Operations and Recovery: Cover monitoring, backup/restore, upgrades and rollback.

prompts.Modules and Navigation: Describe screens/features, navigation and module ownership.
prompts.State and Data Flow: Define observation/state ownership, async work, persistence boundaries and errors.
prompts.Source Folder Structure: Provide Swift/app source organization and dependency boundaries.
prompts.Supported Devices and OS: Specify deployment target, device classes and accessibility constraints.

prompts.Permissions and Entitlements: List capabilities, permission requests, denial/revocation behavior, or N/A with reason.
prompts.Lifecycle and Background Work: Describe launch, foreground/background transitions, cancellation and platform limitations.
prompts.Platform Integrations: Cover required notifications, deep links, system surfaces and integration failures, or explicit none.

prompts.Environments and Configuration: Define build configurations, endpoints and secrets handling.
prompts.Signing and Distribution: Describe app identity, signing, provisioning, TestFlight/App Store or agreed distribution.
prompts.Verification and Recovery: Define device testing, release checks and recovery strategy without unsupported rollback promises.

authentication.trigger: Login, multiple access roles or account recovery.

prompts.Actors and Sessions: Define identities, login/session lifecycle and roles.
prompts.Authorization and Recovery: Specify permissions, session expiry/revocation, recovery and failure paths.

prompts.Purchase Lifecycle: Define provider, purchase states, entitlements and user flows.
prompts.Failures and Reconciliation: Cover retries, duplicate callbacks, refunds, cancellation and verification.

offline-sync.trigger: Offline edits later synchronize with another authority.

prompts.Authority and Queues: Define offline data ownership and queued operations.
prompts.Conflicts and Recovery: Specify merge policy, duplicate prevention, failed sync and user visibility.

background-jobs.trigger: Work outlives requests/foreground sessions and needs scheduling, retries or cancellation.

prompts.Job Lifecycle: Define triggering, states, ownership and cancellation.
prompts.Retries and Operations: Specify idempotency, retry limits, failure visibility and recovery.

realtime.trigger: Live updates, subscriptions or streamed events.

prompts.Events and Transport: Define event schema, transport and subscriptions.
prompts.Ordering and Reconnection: Specify ordering, duplicate handling, resume, backpressure and unavailable history.

file-storage.trigger: Uploads need storage, access rules, processing or retention.

prompts.Upload and Access: Define file types, limits, ownership, storage provider and access.
prompts.Processing and Lifecycle: Cover processing, failed uploads, retention, deletion and backups.

mcp-tools.trigger: AI clients operate the application through MCP.

prompts.Tools and Schemas: Specify tool inputs, outputs, errors, identity and related API contracts.
prompts.Transport and Compatibility: Describe transports, client capability negotiation and required compatibility tests.
prompts.Authorization and Failure Paths: Define mutation enforcement, approval links, cancellation and unsupported clients.
prompts.Schemas and Examples: Define input/output schemas and examples for each actual tool. Cover approval pending/success/error where relevant. Use local shared schema refs and contracts/manifest.json; tool annotations do not enforce authorization.

approval-flow.trigger: Actions require human approval or staged authorization.

prompts.Actions and Approvers: State what requires approval and who can approve.
prompts.Request State Machine: Cover pending, acceptance, rejection, cancellation, expiry and UI representation.
prompts.Binding and Concurrency: Bind approval to exact change/target/revision and handle stale or replayed decisions.
prompts.Interfaces and Enforcement: Describe API/MCP/data enforcement and unsupported approval behavior.

document-history.trigger: Content has retained versions, comparison or restoration.

prompts.Version Lifecycle: Define current/history representation, retention and timestamps.
prompts.Compare and Restore: Specify read access, diff, restore authorization, concurrency and unavailable versions.

activity-logging.trigger: A user-facing activity feed or audit trail is required.

prompts.Event Content and Provenance: Define event schema, actor attribution, labels and observed vs reported sources.
prompts.Access and Retention: Cover filters, access, redaction, retention, cleanup and failure behavior.
